meta.title: Requests rose 34,000× in six years, but yearly growth is easing

cards.title: Why a log axis
items: Volume runs from 12 thousand to 410 million requests a month — a factor of about 34,000.
On a linear axis the first four years would sit flat against the baseline, indistinguishable from zero.
Year-over-year growth eased from 11.7× to 6.4×. On a log axis a constant rate is a straight line, so that slowdown shows as the gentle bend.
